children: NRW's announcement of roughly 313 million Australian dollars in contract awards adds to earnings visibility and confidence the contractor can meet FY27 guidance, says bull Euroz Hartleys. "The existing order book provides a high degree of visibility, while upside remains from stronger activity across electrical and HVAC [heating, ventilation and air conditioning] services, resources civil work, mining ramp-ups and further margin improvement," it says. The broker keeps a buy rating and A$9.06/share price target on the stock. Shares are up 0.1% at A$7.70. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
